theme_rankings.risk: 스마트컨트랙트 위험 + 규제. 매출은 시장 변동성에 큰 폭으로 변동.

theme_rankings.why_now: 거버넌스보단 실제 트래픽·결제 사용처. TON·BNB 일일 활성 유저 검증.
theme_rankings.risk: 투기 대비 변동성 낮지만 폭발력도 작음. 환희장에서 underperform.

theme_rankings.tagline: 📈 ETF 승인 후보 + 이더 L2 — 기관 매집 영역

theme_rankings.risk: ETF 미승인 시 단기 조정. L2는 fee market 경쟁 심화.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🌐 검증된 L1 — 이더 외 실수요 입증된 체인들

theme_rankings.risk: L1 간 경쟁 격화. 사용자·개발자 이탈 시 멀티플 빠르게 축소.

theme_rankings.why_now: 기관 자금 유입 가장 빠른 영역. BlackRock·Franklin 등 진입.
theme_rankings.risk: 규제 의존적. 거시 금리 환경 변화 시 단기 자금 이탈 가능.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🤖 크립토 버전 AI 베팅 — 분산 컴퓨팅·에이전트

theme_rankings.risk: 내러티브 의존도 큼. 실수요 검증 아직 미흡. 알트 변동성 폭.

theme_rankings.why_now: 토큰 가격은 하락했지만 매출 폭증 중. AI Capex 사이클의 크립토 노출 직접.

top_news.title: Bloomberg Money 7/10/2026
top_news.summary: Bloomberg Money takes the pulse of your financial life, powered by the reporting of our global newsroom. Today's guests are: University of Chicago Booth School Professor of Economics and Former Fed Governor Randall Kroszner and NewEdge Wealth CIO Cameron Dawson. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: SK Hynix Debut Is a Bet That AI Breaks Boom-and-Bust Chip Cycle
top_news.summary: South Korean memory chipmaker SK Hynix Inc. just pulled off the largest public listing by a foreign company in US market history. Shares soared 13% on their first day of trading.

top_news.title: Rhode Island Jail Operator Files Bankruptcy to Cut Bond Debt
top_news.summary: Central Falls Detention Facility Corp., which houses federal detainees including people arrested by the US Immigration and Customs Enforcement agency, filed for bankruptcy saying it cannot afford to keep paying on more than $167 million in bond debt.

top_news.title: Insuring Rare and Collectible Cars and Boats: Masters in Business with McKeel Hagerty
top_news.summary: Barry sits down with with CEO and Chairman of Hagerty, McKeel Hagerty. They discuss how he transformed the the family boat insurance business into a "sexy" driver forward business. Barry and McKeel also discuss their love of collectable cars and his love of his first car, a Porsche, that he bought at the age of 13. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: A Hidden-Debt Scandal Derails Senegal's Infrastructure Dream
top_news.summary: Unfinished railway is emblematic of the country’s fiscal strains.

top_news.title: The Grueling Economics of Tennis
top_news.summary: Some of the world’s top tennis players will face off at the Wimbledon finals this weekend. The players who make it to Centre Court have already achieved a bigger feat: a career as a tennis player. On today’s Big Take podcast, Bloomberg’s Hannah Miller and The Athletic’s Matt Futterman break down what sets tennis apart from other sports and the challenges the tournaments and players face to stay profitable. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Meta Shares Gain Most Since April 2025 | Closing Bell
top_news.summary: Comprehensive cross-platform coverage of the U.S. market close on Bloomberg Television, Bloomberg Radio, and YouTube with Romaine Bostick, Katie Greifeld, Carol Massar and Isabelle Lee. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Gotham FC Announces Move to Etihad Stadium in 2028
top_news.summary: Gotham FC governor Carolyn Tisch-Blodgett is joined by Bloomberg's Vanessa Perdomo-Maglione to discuss the NWSL club's historic move to Etihad Stadium in Queens in 2028. Tisch-Blodgett said that its the 'duty' of the league and every team to take excitement from global events like the World Cup and translate it into 'lifelong fandom.' (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: More Americans Are Getting Prenups, Even If They Aren't Rich
top_news.summary: Bloomberg's Nikki Waller joins Scarlet Fu and Tom Keene on "Bloomberg Money." Belle Burden’s blockbuster memoir, 'Strangers,' has riveted readers with the tale of her marriage’s sudden implosion and aftermath. They also discuss the rising popularity of prenups has been driven by changing financial dynamics of marriage. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: US Stock Futures Slip After Tech Rally, SK Hynix Starts Trading
top_news.summary: US equities posted gains for a second consecutive week, even as investors digested the record US listing of South Korea’s SK Hynix Inc. and renewed tensions in Iran ahead of second-quarter earnings.
